name: Parker Neuschburn
original_name: パーカー・ノイシュバーン
source:
[i]“My brother here believes in you from the bottom of his heart. How could I not give you the same courtesy?”[/i]

[i]Gilded Jewel Sword[/i]

The arrogant second-born prince of the Kingdom of Hystorica. He's a selfish and haughty sort. Though his mother's high standing in the nobility gives him relative freedom, he's not exactly well liked. Though he's as eligible for the throne as his brothers, he's chosen to support Conrad, believing him to be the most worthy. Incidentally, the three brothers all have different mothers.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/english/characters/?page=parker]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
